[b]Venezion[/b]

The Federation of Venezion is a tiny, socially conservative nation set along a temperate, coastal landscape. Known for its natural beauty and resilient spirit, Venezion is home to 7 million citizens who take pride in their unique national identity. Venezion operates as a representative republic, where citizens elect officials to govern on their behalf. The government, though small in size, is firmly committed to promoting Security, Peace, and Justice. Its economy is a powerhouse relative to its size, valued at 850 billion Credits annually, with a GDP per capita of 70,000. Driven by the private sector, the economy thrives on military manufacturing, finance, mining, technology, and tourism, with wealth distributed evenly across society. Now, after years of inward focus, Venezion is ready to open its doors to the world, seeking new partnerships, cultural exchange, and a stronger voice in the global community.
